key_terms.لَغْو: frivolity, vain talk, or useless activity

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to turn away from frivolity in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a comprehensive ethical guideline where 'vain talk' (al-laghw) encompasses not only idle chatter but also any activity that distracts from spiritual mindfulness (muraqabah). It underscores the believer's active discipline in filtering their speech and actions to maintain purity of heart, a trait highly valued in the conduct of the Ahl al-Bayt.
